traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet intensity. All-or-nothing attraction, deep desire, and a strong pull toward control in relationships. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of connection and power is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Magnetic and persuasive; the intensity has to be moderated.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity fused with control and obsession, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.summary: Wanting something badly can make the price of having it strangely easy to ignore.
readerCopy.body: Wanting something badly can make the price of having it strangely easy to ignore. When Venus conjuncts Pluto, attraction, money, loyalty, and attachment intensify, which can make a relationship, deal, purchase, or commitment feel too important to risk losing even when the terms give someone else more leverage than you are comfortable admitting. The depth of the feeling does not automatically make the arrangement fair. Notice what saying no would cost you and make sure desire has not quietly become the reason you no longer feel free to choose.
